title: Clip match
description: One measured animation clip (F6, AM5), recorded by the Animator (data/clips/<id>.json). Frame data must match it (F2). Frames are 60-tick game frames, 1-based.

source.description: Generator library preset or prompt-generated take (Meshy or Tripo), video motion capture of a designer performance, or a bought motion-capture pack such as ActorCore (F6, AM5).

clip.description: Library preset name, or the generated take's id/file under the clip spec in assets/specs/clips/.

trim_start.description: Raw tick (60 per second, in the take's GLB) shown on game frame 1. Set with trim_end. Read by ClipCatalog before the notes.

trim_end.description: Last raw tick of the trim (inclusive); playback clamps here. Set with trim_start.

speed_scale.description: Raw ticks per game frame: game frame n shows raw tick trim_start + (n-1) * speed_scale. Default 1.

retime.description: Optional retiming curve (F2, AM5, YOK-113); replaces speed_scale when present. Segment {frames:[a,b], ticks:[ta,tb]} shows raw tick ta + (tb-ta)*(f-a)/(b-a) on game frame f (a <= f <= b). Neighbours share their boundary frame and tick (next.frames[0] = frames[1], next.ticks[0] = ticks[1]); the first starts on frame 1, the last ends on frames_total. Each segment plays at 0.5x-2x ((tb-ta)/(b-a)) or holds (tb = ta); a held tick shows on at most 4 game frames. Ticks lie inside trim_start..trim_end when the trim is set. Limits checked by tools/validate_data.py.

frames.description: First and last game frame of the segment (inclusive, 1-based); last > first.

ticks.description: Raw tick (60 per second, in the take's GLB) shown on the segment's first and last frame.

note.description: Why, e.g. 'startup snaps', 'hit pose holds', 'recovery eases out'.

file.description: The take's GLB, relative to game/ (normally assets/generated/clips/<fighter>/<file>.glb).

yaw_offset.description: Degrees the take is turned about the vertical axis relative to the fighter's facing (presentation only). Default 0.

hit_start.description: First frame the clip visibly hits or releases a projectile; null for clips that never hit (e.g. a teleport).

retarget_notes.description: Retarget result per yokai (G4), e.g. tail/shell/club clipping.
